title: Traefik native middleware runner had a hard-coded UDS path boundary
summary: The mandatory native middleware target failed because the authorized private root exceeded the Unix-socket path limit; a shorter override is not supported.
summary_de: Das verpflichtende Native-Middleware-Target scheiterte, weil der autorisierte private Root das Unix-Socket-Path-Limit überschritt; ein kürzeres Override wird nicht unterstützt.
observed_behavior: The mandatory native middleware target failed because the authorized private root exceeded the Unix-socket path limit; a shorter override is not supported.
observed_behavior_de: Das verpflichtende Native-Middleware-Target scheiterte, weil der autorisierte private Root das Unix-Socket-Path-Limit überschritt; ein kürzeres Override wird nicht unterstützt.
expected_behavior: The native runner selects a validated short task-owned parent in explicit, TMPDIR, then generated-fallback order and rejects unsafe paths before socket creation.
expected_behavior_de: Der Native-Runner wählt einen validierten kurzen task-owned Parent in der Reihenfolge explizit, TMPDIR und erzeugter Fallback und lehnt unsichere Pfade vor der Socket-Erstellung ab.
impact: The path-length boundary is repaired and focused controls pass. Real Traefik/libmodsecurity host lifecycle evidence remains unavailable; final cleanup, manifest leaf removal, and post-readiness endpoint identity limitations are separately tracked by FND-PARENT-0013, FND-PARENT-0014, and FND-PARENT-0015.
impact_de: Die Path-Length-Grenze ist repariert und fokussierte Controls bestehen. Reale Traefik/libmodsecurity-Host-Lifecycle-Evidence bleibt nicht verfügbar; finale Cleanup-, Manifest-Leaf-Entfernungs- und Post-Readiness-Endpoint-Identity-Grenzen werden getrennt durch FND-PARENT-0013, FND-PARENT-0014 und FND-PARENT-0015 verfolgt.
preconditions: An explicit parent or TMPDIR, when used, is an existing current-user-owned 0700 directory outside the checkout without symlink components.
The genuine host lifecycle still requires locally available Traefik and libmodsecurity runtime inputs.
reproduction: Set a long or unsafe UDS parent before the hardened runner selection, or inspect the focused parent/path contract tests.

evidence.command: TMPDIR=<task-tmp> BUILD_ROOT=<active-run-build> TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_TEST_PARENT=<task-tmp> PYTHON=/root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python MODSECURITY_INCLUDE_DIR=<verified-prefix>/include MODSECURITY_LIB_DIR=<verified-prefix>/lib make -C connectors/traefik test-engine-service

current_task_update.root_cause: The Parent native runner forced a UDS directory below /var/tmp and did not expose a validated short parent selection.
current_task_update.security_assessment: Configured parents require an absolute, current-user-owned 0700 directory outside the checkout without symlink components or control characters; generated YAML quotes the socket scalar; fallback allocation creates and removes only a private generated parent. The C service double-observes pathname identity around a bounded SO_PEERCRED self-probe before capturing ownership. FND-PARENT-0013 tracks final socket cleanup, FND-PARENT-0014 manifest leaf deletion, and FND-PARENT-0015 post-readiness client endpoint identity; no strict same-UID claim is made.
current_task_update.runtime_limitation: Real Traefik/libmodsecurity Allow/Block lifecycle execution remains blocked_environment because the required host binary and runtime inputs are unavailable.
current_task_update.strict_cleanup_disposition: partial; FND-PARENT-0013 and FND-PARENT-0014 remain blocked, and FND-PARENT-0015 blocks a same-UID endpoint-integrity claim.

root_cause: The Parent runner used a hard-coded /var/tmp child and did not expose a safe validated short-parent selection. It is not a Framework-owned code change.
root_cause_de: Der Parent-Runner verwendete ein hard-coded /var/tmp-Kind und stellte keine sichere validierte Short-Parent-Auswahl bereit. Es ist keine Framework-eigene Codeänderung.
proposed_remediation: Make the supported test harness UDS root configurable or otherwise shorten it through an authorized interface.
proposed_remediation_de: Den unterstützten Test-Harness-UDS-Root konfigurierbar machen oder ihn über eine autorisierte Schnittstelle verkürzen.
acceptance_criteria: The native Traefik runner selects an authorized task-owned UDS root without path-length failure.
Focused path, YAML, parent identity, collision, startup, protocol, Allow, Blocking, and ordinary shutdown controls pass.
The separate strict same-UID final-cleanup issue is tracked rather than silently treated as fixed.
validation_plan: Run focused Python runner contracts and native C17 engine-service controls.
Run the genuine native Traefik lifecycle with the supported configuration interface when host inputs are available.
Verify no external or original MRTS path is modified.
legitimate_control_tests: Focused C engine Allow control and Blocking control through the native protocol lifecycle.
current_task_correction: This later Parent-only update supersedes the earlier TMPDIR/generated-fallback statement: the production runner now requires TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT only, receives it as process-environment data, and the native Make target preserves raw values before Python validation. FND-PARENT-0019 records the separately reproduced pre-validation Make/shell interpretation defect and its local repair.
current_task_correction_de: Dieses spätere Parent-only-Update übersteuert die frühere TMPDIR-/Generated-Fallback-Aussage: Der Produktions-Runner verlangt nur TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT, erhält ihn als Prozess-Environment-Daten, und das native Make-Target bewahrt Raw-Werte vor der Python-Validierung. FND-PARENT-0019 dokumentiert den getrennt reproduzierten Pre-Validation-Make-/Shell-Interpretationsdefekt und seine lokale Reparatur.
residual_risk: The hard-coded short-path boundary is fixed. Live host runtime is blocked_environment, and distinct same-UID cleanup, manifest leaf, and post-readiness endpoint-identity limitations remain open in FND-PARENT-0013, FND-PARENT-0014, and FND-PARENT-0015; no risk has been accepted.
residual_risk_de: Die hard-coded Short-Path-Grenze ist behoben. Die Live-Host-Runtime ist blocked_environment, und getrennte Same-UID-Cleanup-, Manifest-Leaf- und Post-Readiness-Endpoint-Identity-Grenzen bleiben in FND-PARENT-0013, FND-PARENT-0014 und FND-PARENT-0015 offen; es liegt keine Risikoakzeptanz vor.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.
Ownership was corrected to Parent. The configurable private UDS-parent implementation and focused path/security contract tests passed; live host runtime validation remains blocked_environment.

The short-parent remediation remains fixed. C17 self-probe/double-observation controls and focused contracts passed; the distinct final same-UID pathname cleanup boundary is tracked by FND-PARENT-0013 and keeps strict cleanup partial.

The short-parent remediation remains fixed in scope. Final review added distinct manifest-leaf and post-readiness endpoint-identity findings, FND-PARENT-0014 and FND-PARENT-0015, without claiming them fixed.
The production runner now requires only TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT. FND-PARENT-0019 retains the raw Make forwarding evidence; no generated or TMPDIR parent selection remains.
